custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, whose Part History has one entry split into a bin location A row and a bin location B row.
  • Start on part A's Part History page (the clock icon at the left of its row).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425779-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425779-, so searching for that finds them all.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry shows only its bin location A row; the bin location B row is hidden.

Step 2:

  • Part A's entry shows both bin rows: a Staff name match shows every bin row.
